rows.title: Land and drop your bags
rows.desc: MIA is about 20 minutes from the house and FLL is 40 to 50. Share an Uber with anyone landing around the same time.

rows.title: If you’re in early
rows.desc: Rest at the house or walk around the Design District. Nothing’s planned until dinner.

rows.title: Welcome dinner at Mangrove
rows.desc: A relaxed first night. Jamaican food and cocktails downtown at 103 NW 1st Ave. The kitchen is open until 11:45 on Fridays and there’s a DJ later. Around $30 each before drinks.

rows.title: Out, if you’re up for it
rows.desc: unKommon Art Week at Little River Studios is a few blocks from the house. Tickets on DICE.

days.shot: Your first look at the fair

rows.title: Breakfast at Libertino Cafe
rows.desc: Wynwood, 2659 NW 2nd Ave. Good coffee, milk bread sandwiches and waffles.

rows.title: Galleries
rows.desc: We’ll walk through Wynwood and the Design District. ICA Miami is free, and Superblue is $42 if you want to add it.

rows.title: Lunch at The Taco Stand
rows.desc: Wynwood, 313 NW 25th St, a short walk from the galleries. Fish tacos and carne asada fries. Cheap and quick before the fair.

rows.title: Water taxi to the fair
rows.desc: Free. Boats leave the Venetian Marina, 1635 N Bayshore Dr, every 7–9 minutes for Maurice Gibb Park in Miami Beach. A free shuttle goes from there to the fair.

rows.title: Art Basel Miami Beach
rows.desc: Miami Beach Convention Center, open until 6. The $92 day ticket is all we need.

rows.title: Home to get ready
rows.desc: Water taxi back, or a shared ride.

rows.title: Dinner
rows.desc: Still deciding between somewhere special and somewhere more affordable. I’ll confirm closer to the date.

rows.title: Everyday People
rows.desc: The Art Week party, Saturday, December 5 at Wynwood Marketplace. Last year tickets were about $35.

rows.title: VOUS Church
rows.desc: Design District, 77 NE 40th St. Services at 10 and 12.

rows.title: Matcha at Bigface
rows.desc: 40 NE 40th St, across the street.

rows.title: Magic City Flea Market
rows.desc: At Ironside in Little River, 7580 NE 4th Ct, a few minutes from the house. Vintage clothes, handmade pieces and art from local vendors. It usually opens at noon on Sundays. I’ll confirm the hours for that weekend.

rows.title: Wynwood Walls
rows.desc: About $12–15, and an hour is plenty.

rows.title: Casa Neos
rows.desc: A day party on the Miami River. About $100–150 each. If you’re flying home Sunday, pack in the morning and head to the airport from here.

rows.title: Takeout at the house
rows.desc: For whoever’s still around. Everyone covers their own.

days.shot: The last view before you fly

rows.title: Coffee, then pack
rows.desc: Checkout is at 11, which I’m confirming with the host. We’ll bring our bags with us.

rows.title: Work from Miami
rows.desc: A coworking space in Wynwood or a café with good Wi-Fi. We’ll pick one closer to the date.

rows.title: Or take the day off
rows.desc: A swim, anything we missed, or a long lunch.

rows.title: Nikki Beach
rows.desc: A few of us are going. We’ll aim for a table, which has a $50 minimum spend per person. If you want to join, let me know in the RSVP.

rows.title: Airport
rows.desc: For flights around 9. Leave extra time for FLL.
